component: Custom OAuth settings, default outgoing mapping and cache identity

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The selected IMAP settings flow generates and persists an internal issuer UUID when custom details are enabled and no issuer exists. Accepting the dialog copies that issuer and custom fields to the account's default associated SMTP server, with identity and SMTP guards. OAuth2Module includes the internal loginOrigin in cache matching. The settings test checks UUID shape, shared saved values and disabling; it does not authenticate or validate an external issuer response. POP3, client-secret and issuerIdentifier additions visible in accepted source are later phases.
title: The IMAP settings dialog shares a persisted internal OAuth issuer with its default SMTP server
